#: This gets merged into every version as #/local.
The zeroth element of this is always null since there is no version 0.

url.title: URL
url.description: URL of Esmond server which will collect the result.

bind.title: Bind
bind.description: Address to bind to for outbound connection.

_auth-token.title: Auth Token
_auth-token.description: The authorization token to be used when submitting the result.

measurement-agent.title: Measurement Agent
measurement-agent.description: The name of the system doing the measurement.

verify-ssl.title: Verify SSL
verify-ssl.description: Require a SSL certificate verifiable by known certificate autorities.  This should be disabled if the Esmond server's certificate is self-signed.

retry-policy.title: Retry Policy
retry-policy.description: Policy for retrying failed attempts to archive to the Esmond server.

data-formatting-policy.title: Formatting Policy
data-formatting-policy.description: Indicates how the record should be stored.
data-formatting-policy.x-description-append: Must be one of prefer-mapped, mapped-and-raw, mapped-only or raw-only.

event-type.title: Event Type
event-type.description: The type of event being summarized.

summary-type.title: Summary Type
summary-type.x-description-append: Must be one of aggregation, average or statistics.

summary-window.title: Window
summary-window.description: Time range in seconds to be summarized.
